items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Ed Maugham was one of those. I think he liked Barrel House music. [INTERVIEWEE] Mm-hmm.

ctx.x: And being impressed with the, both with the paintings and with the non-conventional technique that he used in them. I'm sure, you know, there've all, there always have been people who didn't necessarily believe everything their parents told them. Well, I didn't, yeah, I didn't think that, uh,
Ed Maugham was one of those. I think he liked Barrel House music.
